mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as valuation pressures ease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low-rate environments are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that accelerates consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the signal fails to outperform market by ≥0.5% average return.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth acceleration (GDPC1) and housing starts expansion (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1/HOUST signal fails to produce positive returns in > 50% of 60-day windows, or interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery, rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects normalized manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not yield positive returns in > 50% of cases over 20 days within the recovery regime, or return difference from baseline is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 5.0, or the signal does not significantly underperform the market (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate labor market strength that fuels wage growth and consumption, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The PAYEMS/UNRATE joint signal fails to generate positive returns in > 50% of 60-day windows, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) consistently reflects elevated consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or RSAFS strength does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (correlation coefficient < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that precedes equity market gains, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not produce positive 5-day returns in > 50% of cases during early-cycle expansion, or return difference from baseline is insignificant (p > 0.05).
